# Stellar Neighborhood · data credits

The directions, astrometric quality fields, and G magnitudes come from ESA [Gaia](https://www.cosmos.esa.int/gaia) DR3, processed by the [Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium](https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/dpac/consortium). Credit ESA/Gaia/DPAC. DPAC is funded by national institutions, in particular those participating in the Gaia Multilateral Agreement.

- Gaia Collaboration et al. (2016), *The Gaia mission*, [A&A 595, A1](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/201629272).
- Gaia Collaboration et al. (2023), *Gaia Data Release 3: Summary of the content and survey properties*, [A&A 674, A1](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243940).
- [ESA acknowledgments and citations](https://gea.esac.esa.int/archive/documentation/GDR3/Miscellaneous/sec_credit_and_citation_instructions/).

The Gaia DR3 fields and their derived directions are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 IGO (CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/3.0/igo/). The license permits noncommercial reuse. The ESA archive terms require separate ESA authorization before commercial use. [Official Gaia data licence](https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia-users/license) · [ESA archive terms](https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/esdc/terms-and-conditions).

The geometric distance quantiles are from C.A.L. Bailer-Jones, J. Rybizki, M. Fouesneau, M. Demleitner and R. Andrae (2021), *Estimating Distances from Parallaxes. V.*, [AJ 161, 147](https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/abd806). The distance catalogue is [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). [Author's catalogue](https://bailer-jones.www3.mpia.de/gedr3_distances.html) · [GAVO licence and join description](https://dc.g-vo.org/gedr3dist/q/cone/form) · [VizieR I/352](https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/I/352).

The combined product selects rows from the documented DR3/Bailer-Jones ID join and derives projected positions from ICRS directions and geometric posterior medians. The quantiles and measurement values in the detail pages retain their source decimal values. Labels for the three verified First-Light stars reference [ESA's identification](https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/iow_20250513). The two catalogue licences apply to their respective material. The mixed product includes NC material. Website source code has separate terms.
